effective_unresolved_question: List the description of school grades that every district has.

interpretations.effective_text: List the common descriptions of school grades for all districts.
interpretations.gold_sql: SELECT School_Grades.description  from District_School_Grades join School_Grades on District_School_Grades.school_grade_id = School_Grades.id join District on District_School_Grades.district_id = District.id   GROUP BY District_School_Grades.school_grade_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT District_School_Grades.district_id) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM  District)

interpretations.effective_text: For every district, list the description of school grades.
interpretations.gold_sql: select district.name , school_grades.description from District_School_Grades join School_Grades on District_School_Grades.school_grade_id = School_Grades.id join District on District_School_Grades.district_id = District.id

effective_unresolved_question: Show me the parameters each weather model uses.

interpretations.effective_text: What parameters are the same for all weather models?
interpretations.gold_sql: SELECT Parameters.parameterName  from Weather_Model_Parameters join Parameters on Weather_Model_Parameters.parameterId = Parameters.parameterID join Weather_Model on Weather_Model_Parameters.weatherModelId = Weather_Model.modelID   GROUP BY Weather_Model_Parameters.parameterId HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT Weather_Model_Parameters.weatherModelId) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM  Weather_Model)

interpretations.effective_text: For every weather model, list the parameters that are used.
interpretations.gold_sql: select weather_model.modelname , parameters.parametername from Weather_Model_Parameters join Parameters on Weather_Model_Parameters.parameterId = Parameters.parameterID join Weather_Model on Weather_Model_Parameters.weatherModelId = Weather_Model.modelID
